title: کیک‌بوکسر انتقام
description: Kickboxer: Vengeance is a 2016 American martial arts film directed by John Stockwell, and starring Dave Bautista, Alain Moussi, Gina Carano, Georges St-Pierre, and Jean-Claude Van Damme. It is the sixth film in the Kickboxer franchise and also serves as a reboot. The film has a similar premise as the first film in the franchise, and follows Kurt Sloan (Moussi) who trains under Master Durand to avenge his brother Eric's death. The film was released in select theaters and video on demand by RLJ Entertainment on September 2, 2016.
